game.facts: GTA VI is OUT (real gameplay exists since launch day). It is set in the state of Leonida (Vice City neon and beaches, Florida-like swamps, the Keys) and stars Jason and Lucia; it has a new HUD and minimap. Platforms: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. NOT GTA VI: GTA V's Los Santos / Blaine County (Vinewood sign, Michael / Franklin / Trevor, GTA V's minimap), GTA Online, mods, other games.

publishing._packaging_note: Captions per platform (publisher.build_captions): YouTube title = search words first ('GTA 6' within title_keyword_within characters) + numbered series, no hashtags in the title (shorts_tag_in_title=true puts #Shorts back); description = AI description (2 keyword-rich sentences) + question + series/keywords + credit + 3-5 hashtags incl. #Shorts (shorts_hashtag). TikTok/Instagram: first line carries 'GTA 6' + topic, then 3-5 hashtags. X: one line of at most x_text_max characters, no links, credit, 3 hashtags. Every post has min_hashtags..5 hashtags (padded from default_hashtags); brand / cheat / low-value hashtags are always dropped.
publishing._no_raw_clips_note: Raw stream clips (the streamer's own voice + subtitles, no narration) are the most 'unoriginal' posts and most of what Instagram flagged - they skip these platforms; narrated videos still go everywhere.

tour._note: Long videos (>= slices*slice_sec*2) -> 3 slices joined. For countdown formats (top 5s), a 150-660 s video is used as one reel of up to whole_video_max_sec.

sources._x_note: x_accounts: video posts from these X accounts join the footage pool (credited as '<account> on X'). Read with the X_COOKIES login, at most every x_cache_hours. Every clip passes the same AI checks.
sources._download_note: Downloads: Dailymotion streams are picked from yt-dlp's format list by height / id (its HLS list often has no height info -> 'Requested format is not available'); yt-dlp info is fetched once per video and reused (--load-info-json); whole short clips are downloaded normally (no ffmpeg sections); a slow section download is stopped early and the part already downloaded is kept if it has salvage_min_sec+; YouTube switches to another player client for the rest of the run when the default one is refused. Searches: search_workers YouTube searches at a time, results clearly older than the launch (approximate date) dropped before any download. review_cache_days: long-video review verdicts reused per clip + section; bad_clip_days: clips a review found not GTA 6 / broken / spoiler / unsafe are not downloaded again. unsafe_title_terms: clips whose title suggests strip clubs etc. rank last (the AI rejects them as unsafe).
sources._launch_note: Only footage uploaded from 2026-11-18 (UTC): GTA 6 unlocked at midnight LOCAL time on Nov 19, which is Nov 18 in UTC for the earliest time zones (New Zealand), so real launch-day videos carry a Nov 18 date. Older 'GTA 6' videos are fakes made in GTA V / mods (the owner caught a GTA V train clip). Every clip also passes authentic.py.

voice._note: Human voice only: Gemini TTS voice 'Fenrir'. Gemini receives ONLY the script (style instructions would be read out loud) - the YouTuber style comes from the AI-written script. If Gemini fails the video is NOT posted; set robot_fallback to true to allow the Microsoft voices below instead.

fx._note: Cold open: a 1.2 s flash of the payoff moment (punched in, white flash into the story). Payoff: riser, boom, punch-in, shake, impact flash; sudden loud actions in the game sound get a punchy hit + small punch-in. Captions: word by word, synced to the voice (Whisper word times when available), current word pops in the highlight colour, key words (numbers, money, hype words) in the emphasis colour + a small punch-in. caption_style: karaoke (whole chunk shown) or reveal (words appear as spoken). question_card: the closing question replaces the banner at the end, then the CTA. smart_cut: Whisper starts/ends the cut at a pause in the footage's own speech and the narration slides into gaps of the in-game dialogue. duck_ratio: how hard the game sound dips under the voice. music_action_boost: music a bit louder on action beats (+50%), still ducked under the voice. All text stays in the TikTok/Reels/Shorts safe zone; low-res footage is zoomed less (max_upscale). Sound effects are generated (no copyright).

video._ground_lines_note: After the edit is picked, each narration line is rewritten by the AI looking at frames of the exact footage it plays over (gemini_writer.ground_lines) - the one-shot script drifted off the picture and the QA line check blocked most Shorts.
video._script_note: Owner 2026-11-22: the AI watches the WHOLE final video and writes ONE script (gemini_writer.write_final_script); a different AI judges it (script_judge.py); lines are checked against the picture; failures go back to the writer for a NEW script. No more frame-by-frame line rewriting (ground_lines is no longer used).

ai_fallback._note: Free backup AIs. 'providers' = order when frames are sent (vision); 'text_providers' = order for text-only jobs (critic, packaging). Cerebras / SambaNova need free keys (CEREBRAS_API_KEY, SAMBANOVA_API_KEY).

formats._note: Video A makes the NEXT format in this list (+ learning + trends); formats with slot_only (the Money Tip) are made only by their own slot (Video B). 'trending' follows the trend radar (trends.py). Position in queue/format_rotation.json.

rotation.name: GTA 6 Money Tip
rotation.brief: A GTA 6 MONEY TIP: explain the ONE way to make money that this footage actually shows - what the player does and where, step by step, in 'you' form, so viewers can copy it. Line 1 is the hook that names the payoff ('This is the easiest money in GTA 6 right now'). End with a question ('How much did you make?').

rotation.must_show: the player actually EARNING money: the cash / money counter on the HUD going up, a payout / sale / reward screen, or picking up cash. Stealing, crashing or destroying things without getting paid on screen does NOT count
rotation._allow_narrated_note: Most real money guides have a YouTuber talking: allowed, their voice is muted and Fenrir explains.
rotation._continuous_note: A how-to must stay in ONE continuous part of the source video: the multi-slice 'tour' edit jumped to unrelated driving footage while the narration was still explaining the method (owner, 2026-11-20).
rotation._evidence_note: The AI must describe the concrete proof on screen (e.g. 'HUD cash goes from $1,200 to $3,600 after opening the safe'). A posted Money Tip (2026-11-21) was mostly a bike chase with vague cash lines.

learning._note: Pulls each video's YouTube views/likes/comments (free, via yt-dlp) and favours the formats that perform best, while still exploring the others.

script_judge._note: Reads the whole narration like a viewer: makes sense? promise kept? entertaining? + certain checks (numbering, fake 'I', repeated words, closing question). Below min_score -> the writer writes a new script; no AI to judge + required -> not posted.

fallback._note: A video slot that posted nothing posts the most viral famous-streamer clip instead (owner 2026-11-21). The run only starts it while less than max_elapsed_min have passed (job timeout 120 min).

stream_clips._note: Viral GTA 6 stream clips (Twitch, Kick, YouTube stream recordings' most-replayed moment) posted with the streamer's real voice + subtitles, no AI voice. Runs every 30 min from .github/workflows/streams.yml. Finds the most-watched GTA 6 streams first (Twitch/Kick live lists, big streamers' YouTube channels), then clips their best moments.

viral_bar._note: A clip is 'viral' when it has at least min_views AND min_views_per_hour. Views differ a lot per platform.

stream_clips._famous_note: Only famous English-speaking streamers: this list, the X clip accounts, or a top English live stream with famous_min_viewers+ viewers right now. The AI also rejects non-English clips.
stream_clips._main_schedule_note: Owner's plan 2026-11-20: viral stream clips are part of Video A (format stream_reactions) instead of separate posts; streams.yml no longer runs on a timer.

long_video._note: Daily 5-10 min YouTube countdown of the day's best GTA 6 stream moments (Twitch, Kick, X clip accounts). Replaces one Short so YouTube's free quota (about 6 uploads/day) still fits: 4 Shorts + 1 long video.
long_video._edit_note: Pro edit: 3-5 s hook on #1 (teaser_sec, slow push-in hook_zoom), COMING UP preview (preview_cuts quick cuts) under the intro line + title card, swipe transitions synced with whooshes, number slam + label, lower-third credit, corner badge, progress bar (one segment per item), end screen of outro_sec with room for YouTube end-screen elements (moving blurred #1; soft generated pad when there is no music).
long_video._approval_note: Long videos are never auto-published: after QA passes they wait for the owner (download from Artifacts, then upload by hand or run the workflow with slot approve_long).
long_video._rotation_note: Owner 2026-11-21: money guides dropped for now - long videos are stream-moment countdowns; when streams are quiet or there aren't enough moments, a trend guide. (money_guide still works manually: format=money_guide.)
long_video._guide_note: Guides: each method from up to 3 creators (main + 2 extra angles, each part narrated with lines about its own footage); 3 methods minimum when that is all the real footage there is (2026-11-20: 3 methods, each confirmed by 2-3 creators).

whisper._note: Open-source speech-to-text running on the GitHub runner (free, no key). 'small' also detects the spoken language (non-English clips are dropped); 'small.en' is English-only and a bit more accurate.

critic._note: A second free AI (GPT-4.1 via GitHub Models first) rewrites titles / banners / hooks for more clicks without inventing anything; originals are kept if a rewrite breaks the rules.
critic._rules_note: A rewrite is rejected if it adds numbers/names not in the video, cheat-sounding words (critic.CHEAT_WORDS; set cheat_words to replace the list - money videos may not use them at all, the AI's own 'Money Hacks' becomes 'Money Tips'), spoiler words, emojis, hashtags, links, 'GTA VI', more than max_caps_words CAPS words, or drops a search keyword the original had (critic.KEEP_TERMS + keep_terms + today's top searches). Titles always get 'GTA 6' near the front and the true countdown number.

_schedule_note: Owner's plan (2026-11-20): Video A (rotation) 19:40 TRT -> Instagram, X, YouTube Shorts (from week 2); Video B (normal rotation, money dropped 2026-11-21) 01:40 TRT -> Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube Shorts; X texts 16:50 / 22:10 / 04:20; long video every 3 days (15:10 TRT, owner publishes). Viral stream clips are part of Video A (no separate posts). Times must match the crons in .github/workflows/main.yml.

qa._note: Strict QA before every publish: technical checks, Whisper voice-vs-captions, AI editor watching the final video. Any high-severity issue = not published.

trends._note: Trend radar (free): YouTube/Google autocomplete, this week's biggest GTA 6 videos, Reddit, Twitch viewers. Streams count as 'weak' below stream_min_viewers or below stream_weak_ratio x the 7-day peak -> trend formats take over.

authenticity._cache_note: Answers are remembered in queue/ai_verdicts.json per source + checked window (a pass is reused only for the same part of the same video; errors are never stored; a prompt / game-facts change invalidates). A video with a confidently fake part is never downloaded again. Channels: every video that passed / failed counts once; a channel with block_channel_after_fakes+ fakes (and more than twice as many fakes as passes) is skipped, channels whose videos passed rank higher.
authenticity._note: Focused 'which game is this?' check on sharp frames for footage from YouTube / Dailymotion / X. Decides on certain signs (places, characters, graphics), never on the HUD alone (the AI has never seen GTA VI's real HUD). Twitch / Kick clips from the GTA VI category are trusted.

music._note: Quiet beat under the narration (ducked under the voice). Own files in music/ first, else CC0 beats from Freesound (FREESOUND_API_KEY, free), cached in queue/music.

lessons._note: Mistakes memory (lessons.py): every QA result is logged; recurring script mistakes + lines that passed go into the writer's prompts; formats that keep failing are rested; first-pass rate logged every run.
